name: HubSpot Deal Loss Reason Trend Analyzer (dhRobin Systems)

parameters.content:
## n8n-hubspot-deal-loss-reason-trend-analyzer
**dhRobin Systems** · Weekly closed-lost theme clustering and executive trend reporting.

**Safe by default.** With no environment variables set, the workflow:
- reads synthetic fixtures (`SANDBOX_MODE=true`)
- classifies with an offline heuristic (`LLM_MODE=mock`)
- publishes nothing (`DRY_RUN=true`, all `PUBLISH_*=false`)

Secrets are referenced only as `$env.*` inside HTTP headers or URLs and never written to node output.

Promotion path: sandbox → HubSpot test account → production. See README.md.

### Pinned test payloads
`HubSpot: Search Closed-Lost Deals` and the three publisher nodes carry **pinned synthetic responses**. Pins apply to manual executions only; scheduled production runs ignore them.

Unpin a node before a manual live test of that integration.

nodes.name: Weekly Cron Trigger
nodes.notes: Mondays 07:00 in the workflow timezone (Settings → Timezone, or GENERIC_TIMEZONE).

assignments.name: reportTitle
assignments.value: ={{ String($env.REPORT_TITLE ?? 'Weekly Deal Loss Trend Report').trim() || 'Weekly Deal Loss Trend Report' }}

nodes.name: Config & Safety Flags
nodes.notes: Single source of non-secret runtime configuration. Secrets are never copied here, so they never appear in execution data.

nodes.name: Build HubSpot Search Window
nodes.notes: Computes current and prior windows (UTC) and the CRM Search request body.

nodes.name: Load Synthetic Fixtures
nodes.notes: Synthetic, fictitious deals for offline testing.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Search Closed-Lost Deals
nodes.notes: POST /crm/v3/objects/deals/search with cursor pagination (100 per page, 250 ms between pages, max 100 pages = HubSpot's 10,000-result ceiling). Requires scope crm.objects.deals.read.

nodes.name: Flatten HubSpot Pages
nodes.notes: Collapses paginated responses into one item.

nodes.name: Sanitize & Normalize
nodes.notes: PII scrubbing, pseudonymous refs, competitor normalisation, period tagging.

nodes.name: Build LLM Clustering Batches
nodes.notes: Chunks records and builds strict JSON-schema Chat Completions requests.

nodes.name: OpenAI: Cluster Loss Themes
nodes.notes: One request per chunk, 1 s apart. Only sanitised text with pseudonymous refs is sent.

nodes.name: Mock LLM Clustering
nodes.notes: Offline keyword classifier returning an OpenAI-shaped response.

nodes.name: Analyze Loss Trends
nodes.notes: Validates model output and computes current-vs-prior trend metrics.

nodes.name: Compose Executive Report
nodes.notes: Renders Markdown, Slack Block Kit, email HTML and Notion blocks.

nodes.name: Dry Run: Report Preview
nodes.notes: Inspect $json.markdown and the channel payloads here. Nothing is sent while DRY_RUN is not 'false'.

nodes.name: Slack: Post Report
nodes.notes: Slack incoming webhook. The webhook URL is itself a secret and is read from $env only.

nodes.name: Email: Send Report
nodes.notes: SendGrid v3 mail/send (returns 202). Swap for your ESP if needed; keep the key in $env.

nodes.name: Notion: Create Report Page
nodes.notes: Creates one page per run in NOTION_DATABASE_ID. Share the database with the integration first.
